digest.component_or_area: Live Jira Cloud Integration Lane & JQL Probing
propositions: JQL search step in bridge check-access flakes on live Jira Cloud due to Lucene index lag exceeding fixed 6x5s retry budget, requiring env-tunable exponential backoff with defaults 10 retries, 3s base, 30s cap

Live Cloud mutation coordinator lifecycle is untested because existing Cloud integration lane is read-only and gated off in CI, requiring a new bounded self-cleaning test module that drives create, binding, commit-unknown recovery, and fuse against one throwaway ticket

Workflow integration requires new jira-cloud-mutation-probe lane that exports REBAR_PROBE_RUN_LABEL, runs check-access preflight and coordinator lifecycle module, and always-executes cleanup sweep of labeled issues via acli with --yes flag to prevent blocking on stdin

Live module must adopt existing issue on simulated create timeout (commit-unknown recovery) by waiting for dedup label visibility via JQL before re-observing, ensuring adoption occurs via dedup path not lag
Test teardown and workflow cleanup must both use identical REBAR_PROBE_RUN_LABEL label scheme to prevent orphaned test issues and guarantee eventual cleanup
